newsitem.title: BELGIUM: UK's Brown "constructive" on EMU-EU's de Silguy.
newsitem.headline: UK's Brown "constructive" on EMU-EU's de Silguy.

text.p: European Union Commissioner Yves Thibault de Silguy said on Monday that Britain's new Chancellor of the Exchequer, Gordon Brown, was ready to work constructively on a single currency.
De Silguy's spokesman said that in a meeting between the two officials earlier this morning, Brown "underlined his wish to work in a constructive manner on the euro".
The spokesman added that Brown took the opportunity to outline his recent decision to give the Bank of England greater independence in setting monetary policy. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
